g.text: SPH neighbour search: cells of side h, only 3 x 3 cells visited
2D slice of spatial/HashGrid (3D: 3 x 3 x 3 = 27 cells). Particle spacing h/2, as in the dam break (h = 2 x spacing).
within h: in the sum (12 with i itself)
in the 9 cells but farther than h: tested, rejected (24)
outside the 9 cells: never looked at (104 of 140)
r_ij = |x_i - x_j|, the sum includes j = i;
W = 0 for r_ij > h, so only orange dots count.
i sits somewhere in the dark cell. A disc of radius
h = cell side can cross at most one cell boundary
in each direction, so every j with r_ij <= h lies in
the 3 x 3 block (3 x 3 x 3 = 27 cells in 3D).
a counting sort keeps each bucket contiguous.
Measured in 3D (dam break, CPU WCSPH): 25.8 to 28.4
